$description: Lumen v0.13 — RESTRAINED mode rebind set. Restrained is the DEFAULT mode and most surfaces already resolve to restrained values via the v0.12.6 semantic layer (color.surface.*, etc.). This file re-aliases the mode-aware tokens (surface.hero / surface.canvas-ambient / motion.atmosphere) to their restrained values for clarity — calm flat-canvas heroes, no animated mesh, no ambient gradients. The semantic split files (surface/text/border/action.tokens.json) carry the actual rebinds for the rest of the system. The atmosphere is muted to zero on restrained; the mode is identified by `[data-mode='restrained']` on a scope container.

name.$description: v0.13 — the default mode. SaaS dashboards, tables, settings, terminals, command palette, every dense operator surface.

atmosphere.$description: Restrained surfaces drop all ambient atmosphere — no aurora, no mesh, no grain. Hairline-frame + content-only.

glass-policy.$description: backdrop-filter is only legal on floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, nav). NEVER on canvas, table, row, cell.

motion-policy.$description: All transitions use motion.easing.decelerate (the Lumen default). Bounce + emphasised reserved for celebration moments only.

canvas.$description: Solid obsidian canvas #0D0D0D. NEVER mesh on the page canvas — even in expressive mode the canvas stays solid; mesh sits on surface.hero.

hero.$description: Restrained hero = flat obsidian. Calm. The brutalist headline + italic accent word + mono-cap label carry the voice; the surface is intentionally quiet so they pop.

canvas-ambient.$description: Restrained mode: ambient layer collapses to canvas (no gradient overlay).

atmosphere.$description: Restrained mode: zero atmospheric overlay. Hairlines do the surface separation.
Restrained mode: no animated atmosphere. Aurora, mesh-drift, grain animations all gated off.
